title: 2.1.3 release readiness: the MOSS release (MOSS-Image, Multi-angle, Singularity H3)
description: The MOSS release = 2.1.3 (Fabio, 2026-10-25). Done, waiting on this release: MOSS-Image and its follow-ups (MPI-1243, MPI-1245, MPI-1249, MPI-1253); MPI-1284 Singularity H3 as its OWN model (MiniMax H3 Reference keeps the original weight and stays recommended in Video Edit: Singularity did not copy the source's moves at 960) + sol-attn on both H3 models + Video Edit Fast Motion above 768p; MPI-1285 Fast Motion on H3 Reference. Still open: Multi-angle Flow (MPI-1039, ships with MOSS per Fabio 2026-10-24); MPI-1283 (MiniMax's two sections in every H3 reference prompt, Fabio 2026-10-26: do it now, rides along if it lands before the cut). NOTHING is deprecated or retired: MiniMax H3 (fl2va) stays as the i2v model, and the original ref2va weight stays. Waits on 2.1.3 but is NOT in it: MPI-1299 (Draw It In) researches and benches now, wiring after the release. LTX 2.5 is NOT in this release (MPI-1267). Version number and the cut stay Fabio's call.
